question: #11916: the Tooltip layer mounts at the first show. Does the first show still open on time, in place, without a flash, and is the page at rest unchanged?

stories.touch: core-tooltip--touch-triggers (a Save button, the inline term "hover-able term", a "?" button with touchTrigger="tap")

method.modes: Storybook global colorMode and the page color scheme

cases.hover-first: the pointer enters the button from 300 px to its right in 3 steps
cases.hover-second: a first hover, the pointer leaves for 900 ms, then the measured hover
cases.focus-first: Tab until the button holds focus
cases.tap-term: a tap on the inline term (no action of its own)
cases.tap-term-second: a first tap on the term, a tap on empty page to close it, then the measured tap
cases.tap-save: a tap on the Save button (an action)
cases.long-press-term: a finger held 900 ms on the term, then lifted (CDP touch events)
cases.tap-help: a tap on the "?" button with touchTrigger="tap"

method.timing: ms from the start event (pointerenter, focusin, pointerup; pointerdown for the long press) to the first animation frame where the tooltip is visible; the tooltip is read on every animation frame for 1.6 s
method.visible: checkVisibility with opacity and visibility, and the product of ancestor opacities above 0.01
method.drift: the largest distance of the visible tooltip box from its last visible box during the watch
method.flash: visible in one frame and gone in a later frame of the same watch
method.requests: every network request from the gesture to the end of the watch (CDP)
method.rest: the viewport with no interaction (the pointer at the top-left corner on desktop), compared by pixels
